ActionSpec.description: Something an agent can do. Each legal action becomes one typed tool.

by.description: Agent type(s) allowed to take it.
by.title: By

when.description: Requirements (one or a list). Those over $actor decide whether the tool is offered; those that read $params refuse a call that breaks them, with their `why`. They may not draw at random (nor may parameters' bounds, defaults, values or `where`): a refused call costs nothing, so an agent could call again until luck let it through — draw in `do` or `chance`.
when.title: When

outcome.description: What the actor is told (template over $actor, $params).
outcome.title: Outcome

announce.description: What everyone else is told: omitted, a default line (a simultaneous stage's leaves out the arguments); a template; or false: nobody else learns this action happened.
announce.title: Announce

terminal.description: Taking it ends the agent's turn: true, or an expression checked after it applies ($actor, $params).
terminal.title: Terminal

attach.description: Assets the actor receives with the result (an expression over $actor, $params giving an asset id, a list or null); a sealed choice's arrive with its outcome.
attach.title: Attach

ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

ArmSpec.description: An experiment variant: input overrides and/or a contract patch.

patch.description: Deep-merged into the contract (objects merge, lists replace).
patch.title: Patch

ArmSpec.title: ArmSpec

Brief.description: Static text every agent receives once per wake, before anything dynamic (cacheable).

situation.description: What this world is and what is going on (template; {$inputs.x} works).
situation.title: Situation

rules.description: How it works: what agents can do and what happens (template).
rules.title: Rules

roles.description: Extra brief per agent type (template over $actor).
roles.title: Roles

attach.description: Assets every agent receives with its brief: an expression over $actor giving an asset id, a list of them, or null.
attach.title: Attach

Brief.title: Brief

Clock.description: How long a run lasts and how rounds are labelled.

unit.description: Name of one round: day, week, turn, hour …
unit.title: Unit

start.description: ISO date of round 1 (adds a calendar date), or an expression over $inputs giving one (`"$inputs.start"`).
start.title: Start

step.description: Units per round (e.g. 7 with unit 'day' = weekly rounds).
step.title: Step

Clock.title: Clock

Condition.description: A requirement: ``"$actor.cash > 0"`` or ``{"expr": ..., "why": "You have no money."}``.
Condition.title: Condition

DefSpec.description:
A named, reusable piece of the rules. With ``expr`` it is an expression called like a built-in:
``$utility($actor, $params.offer)`` (shorthand: the expression text, no arguments). With ``do`` it is an effect
list run by the ``call`` effect: ``{"call": "settle", "with": {"buyer": "$actor"}}``; its effects see only the
arguments (plus $inputs, $world, $round …), never the caller's locals.

args.description: Argument names; the body reads them as roots ($side).
args.title: Args

do.description: The effects it runs, when called with {"call": name}.
do.title: Do

DefSpec.title: DefSpec

EndSpec.description: A condition that ends the run early.

check.description: When it is checked: stage (after the start events, after every stage and at the end of the round) | action (also the moment any action, sealed choice or effect block commits: a winning move ends the run at once).
check.title: Check

EndSpec.title: EndSpec

EntitySpec.description:
A starting entity, whose id is its key. With ``count`` or ``from`` it generates many instead (households from
a table, a crowd of traders): their ids are ``<key>_<n>`` (a row's own ``id``, or the ``id`` template, when given),
and an id already taken is an error. Entities are built in the order they are declared.

name.description: Its name (default: the id). Generated: a template over $row and $i (default: the type's title and the number).
name.title: Name

brief.description: Private text added to this entity's own brief (template; over $row and $i when generated).
brief.title: Brief

count.description: Generate this many (number or expression). Omit with `from` = one per row.
count.title: Count

from.description: Generate from rows: an expression giving them (e.g. $inputs.households).
from.title: From

weight.description: Generated: row sampling weight ($row); sampled without replacement.
weight.title: Weight

EntitySpec.title: EntitySpec

EventSpec.description: World logic outside agent turns: `on` says when it is considered, `when` whether it fires.

on.description: round.start (before the stages) | round.end (after them, before outputs are sampled) | stage.<s>.start (when stage s starts) | stage.<s>.end (after it; a simultaneous stage's choices have committed) | stage.<s>.turn (after each agent's turn in it: $actor, $acted, $timed_out) | create.<t> / remove.<t> (inside the change that creates or removes an entity of type t or a subtype: $it) | change (after every change, the moment `when` becomes true; it re-arms once it is false again).
on.title: On

do.description: Effects, applied atomically. A `do` that is one `each` loop runs item by item, each item with luck of its own.
do.title: Do

once.description: Fire at most once per run.
once.title: Once

EventSpec.title: EventSpec

GraphSpace.description: Named places joined by edges; positions are place names. Distance is the shortest path.

nodes.description: Place names, or an expression over $inputs giving them.
nodes.title: Nodes

edges.description: [a, b] or {from, to, weight}; or an expression over $inputs giving them.
edges.title: Edges

GraphSpace.title: GraphSpace

GridSpace.description: A rows × cols board; positions are [row, col].

rows.description: Number of rows (number or expression over $inputs).
rows.title: Rows

cols.description: Number of columns (number or expression over $inputs).
cols.title: Cols

neighborhood.description: von_neumann (4 neighbours; distance counts steps along rows and columns) | moore (8 neighbours; distance counts king moves) | hex (6 neighbours: a rhombus of hexagons in axial coordinates [r, q], whose neighbours are [r, q±1], [r±1, q], [r-1, q+1] and [r+1, q-1]).
neighborhood.title: Neighborhood

torus.description: The edges wrap around: a position off one side comes back on the other, and distances take the short way.
torus.title: Torus

GridSpace.title: GridSpace

InputSpec.description: A typed value supplied when the environment is loaded (``fg_env.load(..., inputs=)``).

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, enum, list, table, map, date, file, any (`integer`, `float`, `string` and `boolean` are read as int, number, text and bool)
type.title: Type

default.description: Used when the caller supplies nothing.
default.title: Default

required.description: The caller must supply it (no default).
required.title: Required

min.description: The least value of a number; the fewest rows of a table or items of a list.
min.title: Min

max.description: The greatest value of a number; the most rows of a table or items of a list.
max.title: Max

multiple_of.description: Require a multiple of this positive numeric increment, measured from zero; e.g. 0.01 for cents. Unlike step, validates supplied data.
multiple_of.title: Multiple Of

source.description: Load the value from a data file (.csv → table, .json, .jsonl) inside the data directory: the contract file's folder, or `data_dir=` at load. Undeclared CSV columns stay text. A `file` input carries the file (an image, PDF, text, audio) or every file of the folder named here.
source.title: Source

label.description: Human-readable input label; defaults to the input name in a host UI.
label.title: Label

display.description: Optional host UI control. Presentation only: does not change simulation semantics.
display.title: Display

step.description: Suggested numeric control increment; min/max still validate supplied values.
step.title: Step

fields.description: Typed configurable fields of a map object or each table row; supports nested objects, defaults and control hints.
fields.title: Fields

items.description: Typed elements of a list input.

caption.description: file: what the file shows, as agents read it next to the file ({name} is the file name).
caption.title: Caption

alt.description: file: a longer description for readers that cannot see the file (text-only models read it).
alt.title: Alt

max_bytes.description: file: the largest file accepted (default: by kind — image 10 MB, pdf 32 MB, text 2 MB, audio 25 MB, other 32 MB).
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

describe.description: file: a host (a Describer) that writes a caption and extracted text for the file when the world is built, recorded on the host tape: `$asset(id).caption` and `.text` read it.
describe.title: Describe

InputSpec.title: InputSpec

InvariantSpec.description:
Must always hold. Broken by an agent's action (with everything its commit sets off), that action is refused and
undone and the agent told `why`; broken by anything else (events, physics, the build), the run fails.

why.description: What the agent whose action broke it is told: a template, which may read no agent's private property.
why.title: Why

check.description: When it is checked: action (after the build, every action and effect block — a round event's `each` once its last item ran, or before a `change` event or reaction an item sets off — and every round; `$all(<type>, <condition>)` over each member's own properties re-checks only the members that changed) | round (after the build and at the end of every round: much cheaper for sums over big crowds) | end (once, when the run finishes).
check.title: Check

InvariantSpec.title: InvariantSpec

LayerSpec.description:
A value on every cell (grid) or place (graph) without an entity per cell: sugar, pheromone, alive.
Read with ``$layer(name, position)``; changed by the ``layer`` effect.

default.description: Every cell's starting value: a literal, or an expression over $cell (its position) and $inputs.
default.title: Default

min.description: Lowest allowed value: a set below it is refused, never clamped (saturate with $clamp); diffuse and decay stay within it.
min.title: Min

max.description: Highest allowed value: a set above it is refused, never clamped (saturate with $clamp); diffuse and decay stay within it.
max.title: Max

LayerSpec.title: LayerSpec

LinkSpec.description:
Starting links of a relation: one explicit link, links from data rows, or a generated network among a
type.

among.description: Generate links among entities of this type.
among.title: Among

graph.description: complete | ring | random | small_world | scale_free | blocks | lattice | star | bipartite
graph.title: Graph

m.description: scale_free: links each new member makes (preferential attachment).
m.title: M

block.description: blocks: expression over $it giving each member's group; `p` applies within a group, `p_between` across.
block.title: Block

with.description: bipartite: the other type (links run among → with).
with.title: With

hub.description: star: expression giving the hub entity (default: the first member).
hub.title: Hub

rows.description: Edges from data: an expression giving rows with `from`, `to` and optional `value`.
rows.title: Rows

degree.description: Mean neighbours per member (number or expression); on a one-way random graph a link either way makes a neighbour.
degree.title: Degree

p.description: Link probability (random) or rewiring probability (small_world). For random it may depend on the pair: '0.1 if $to.influencer else 0.02'.
p.title: P

props.description: Link field values or expressions over $from and $to ($row too with `rows`, whose columns named like a field fill it).
props.title: Props

LinkSpec.title: LinkSpec

OutputSpec.description:
A typed field of the run result, worked out when the run ends. With ``series`` it is also sampled every round:
``$outputs.x`` reads its latest sample, ``$series.x`` every sample so far (``result.metrics`` and
``result.series``). One worked out from a private property (directly or through a def or another output) is not
shown to agents: `$outputs`/`$series` reads of it in what they are shown are refused.

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, list, map, any
type.title: Type

format.description: How result.summary() and the CLI show it: a template format (money, pct, pct1, int, 0-4 decimals …); the stored value stays exact. Unset: numbers to 4 decimals.
format.title: Format

series.description: Also sample it every round: true samples `expr` (the result is the last sample); an expression samples that instead, when the per-round figure differs from the final one (sales each round, total sales at the end).
series.title: Series

OutputSpec.title: OutputSpec

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, enum, entity, list, file (`integer`, `float`, `string` and `boolean` are read as int, number, text and bool)
type.title: Type

where.description: Which entities qualify ($it, $actor, $params for earlier params, $pending).
where.title: Where

values.description: Allowed values or an expression giving them (type enum).
values.title: Values

step.description: Type number or int: values go in steps of this size from `min` (or 0), which makes the parameter enumerable for games.
step.title: Step

overflow.description: Type text: text longer than `max_len` is refused (the agent is told to shorten it), or with `truncate` cut after the last full sentence that fits (the agent is told what was cut).
overflow.title: Overflow

items.description: Type list: the spec every element follows (e.g. {"type": "enum", "values": [...]}). Shorthand: `of` makes entity items, `values` enum items.

min_items.description: Type list: fewest elements (a number or an expression, like `min`).
min_items.title: Min Items

max_items.description: Type list: most elements (a number or an expression, like `max`).
max_items.title: Max Items

unique.description: Type list: no element twice (rankings, hands of cards).
unique.title: Unique

required.description: Defaults to true unless a default is given.
required.title: Required

invalid.description: What the agent is told when its value is not valid (template over $actor, $params, $value).
invalid.title: Invalid

kinds.description: Type file: the asset types accepted (image, pdf, text, audio, file; default all).
kinds.title: Kinds

max_bytes.description: Type file: the largest file accepted (default: the largest for its kinds).
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

PlaneSpace.description: A width × height area; positions are [x, y]. Distance is straight-line.

torus.description: The edges wrap around (positions and distances, as on a grid).
torus.title: Torus

PlaneSpace.title: PlaneSpace

PolicyRule.description:
One rule of a coded policy: when `when` holds (and the `chance` roll passes), call `do` with `with`.
With `each`, the rule is tried once per item ($it): "for each of my armies, hold".

each.description: A type or expression; the rule is tried for every item ($it).
each.title: Each

PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule

PolicySpec.description: A coded participant: the first rule whose condition holds and whose action is legal is taken.

repeat.description: Keep applying rules until the turn ends (default: one action).
repeat.title: Repeat

PolicySpec.title: PolicySpec

PropSpec.description:
One property. Shorthand: a bare value is the default (``"cash": 100``). An object is always the spec itself, so a
map default is written ``{"default": {"wood": 3}}``.

In a type that ``extends`` another, a property the parent declares is overridden field by
field: only the fields written here change (a bare value changes only the default), so the
parent's ``private``, ``type``, ``min``, ``max`` and ``values`` still apply.

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, enum, list, map, any, asset (inferred from default: any number default, 10 as much as 2.5, is a number, which may hold fractions; int only when declared) (`integer`, `float`, `string` and `boolean` are read as int, number, text and bool).
type.title: Type

default.description: Literal or expression (evaluated when the entity is created).
default.title: Default

min.description: Lowest allowed value: a write below it is refused, never clamped (saturate with $clamp).
min.title: Min

max.description: Highest allowed value: a write above it is refused, never clamped (saturate with $clamp).
max.title: Max

private.description: Hidden from every agent but the entity itself and its owner (the agent its type's `owner` property names); the world's are hidden from all. A list of agent types instead of true also shows it to agents of those types (a chair, an auditor). Reading one in what an agent is shown or offered, or in text sent to several, is an error at run time; a refusal whose rules read one spends the action.
private.title: Private

PropSpec.title: PropSpec

RecordSpec.description: An append-only log (chat, reviews, bids, transcript). New entries reach agents as news.

fields.description: {field: type}; a field holds what a property of its type holds, by the same rules (a number field refuses text, a text field a number). Text fields written by agents are marked untrusted.
fields.title: Fields

visible.description: 'all' or an expression over $viewer and $it (the entry). It filters what agents are shown or offered; game logic reads every entry. An entry's `seq` counts from 1 in what each reader sees of the record (game logic: every entry of every record), so it never tells a reader of entries it cannot see.
visible.title: Visible

keep.description: Keep only the latest N entries.
keep.title: Keep

notify.description: Deliver new entries to agents in 'since your last turn'.
notify.title: Notify

RecordSpec.title: RecordSpec

RelationSpec.description:
A kind of link between entities (follows, trusts, owns …). Every link carries a number
(``value``) and, with ``props``, typed fields of its own (``since``, ``channel``, ``strength``).

default.description: Value of a link made without one (default 1).
default.title: Default

min.description: Lowest allowed link value: a write below it is refused, never clamped (saturate with $clamp).
min.title: Min

max.description: Highest allowed link value: a write above it is refused, never clamped (saturate with $clamp).
max.title: Max

props.description: Typed fields every link carries, read as $link(a, b, kind).field; defaults may be expressions over $from and $to.
props.title: Props

links.description: Links made when the world is built, after the entities.
links.title: Links

RelationSpec.title: RelationSpec

ScoreSpec.description:
What each agent of this type (a seat) scores, for `RunResult.returns`, tournaments, `fg_env.rl.game` and
`fg_env.rl.gym`. The seats are the entities of every type with a score, in creation order unless `seat` orders
them; a reward is the change in a seat's value since its previous step.

value.description: A seat's total score so far: an expression over $it (the seat) and $result, read after every decision and at the end.
value.title: Value

seat.description: Seat order: an expression over $it, lowest first (default: the order entities are created). Every scoring type orders seats the same way.
seat.title: Seat

utility.description: One of: zero_sum, constant_sum, general_sum, identical — the same on every scoring type; zero_sum and identical are checked on every finished run.
utility.title: Utility

min.description: The lowest value a seat can finish with — checked on every finished run.
min.title: Min

max.description: The highest value a seat can finish with — checked on every finished run.
max.title: Max

ScoreSpec.title: ScoreSpec

Space.description: Where entities are (``at``). Declare exactly one of grid, graph, plane.

capacity.description: Most entities one cell (grid) or place (graph) holds: a number for every entity, or {type: number} (subtypes count). Creating or moving an entity into a full cell is refused. Numbers or expressions over $inputs.
capacity.title: Capacity

layers.description: {name: LayerSpec}: values stored on every cell (grid) or place (graph).
layers.title: Layers

Space.title: Space

StageSpec.description:
One step of every round. Stages run in order; each wakes agents to take turns. What happens around a stage (a
resolution when it ends, a default move for an agent that did not act) is an event on the stage's anchors.

when.description: Run this stage only when true (e.g. $round == 1, $round % 7 == 0).
when.title: When

turns.description: sequential (one after another, effects immediate) | simultaneous (everyone chooses from the same picture; the sealed choices then commit one agent after another, in `order` or else a random order — resolve them jointly in an event on `stage.<name>.end`).
turns.title: Turns

order.description: seat | random | expression over $it (lowest first): the order agents take turns in, and a simultaneous stage's choices commit in. Every agent sees it, so it may read no agent's private property. Default: seat; a simultaneous stage's choices then commit in a random order drawn anew each time, so no seat always wins a contested item.
order.title: Order

who.description: Which agents are woken ($it); e.g. $it.alive and $chance(0.3).
who.title: Who

until.description: Repeat turns within the round until true.
until.title: Until

passes.description: Max passes through the agents (default 1, or 10 with until): a number ≥ 1 or an expression over $inputs.
passes.title: Passes

quiet.description: wake | skip — skip agents with nothing new since their last turn.
quiet.title: Quiet

max_actions.description: Actions an agent may take per turn: a number or an expression over $inputs (default 1; left out on a stage mechanisms attach to, the sum of what each allows, and one more for the stage's own actions).
max_actions.title: Max Actions

max_calls.description: Tool calls (including looks) per turn: a number or an expression over $inputs.
max_calls.title: Max Calls

must_act.description: While an action is available, the agent cannot just end its turn.
must_act.title: Must Act

valid.description: Conditions the whole turn must meet when it ends, after the `change` events it sets off ($actor, $pending); if one fails, every action of the turn is undone and the agent is told `why` and plays the turn again. The turn's actions apply together or not at all: events, reactions and invariants wait until it ends, and an action's `outcome` (and attached files) is shown once the turn commits. `"true"` makes the turn atomic with no condition. An action that draws randomness settles the turn so far at once (a failure then undoes the turn and ends it), so no later action can undo its luck.
valid.title: Valid

StageSpec.title: StageSpec

TypeSpec.description:
A kind of entity. ``agent: true`` types take turns. ``extends`` inherits another type:
its props, its agent flag, its lifecycle hooks and membership (``$count(trader)`` counts
every kind of trader).

extends.description: Parent type whose props and role this type inherits.
extends.title: Extends

owner.description: The property naming each entity's owner: the id of the agent (or a list of the ids of the agents) that reads its private properties, as an agent reads its own (`"owner": "seller"` on a listing). Without it, only the entity itself and the agent types a property's `private` lists read them.
owner.title: Owner

policies.description: Coded participants for agents of this type (and its subtypes), played as `policy:<name>`: crowds and baselines.
policies.title: Policies

policy.description: The policy agents of this type play when a run names none.
policy.title: Policy

score.description: What each agent of this type scores as a seat, for returns, tournaments, game search and gyms.

inspect.description: Whether agents may inspect these entities (each agent may always inspect itself): false (default), true, or an expression over $viewer and $it. Inspect shows every property that is not private.
inspect.title: Inspect

TypeSpec.title: TypeSpec

ViewSpec.description: A declared, ranked slice of the world rendered as plain lines for agents.

for.description: Agent type(s) that see it, or "spectator": an omniscient view for UIs and reports, rendered into `result.frames` each round and by `env.spectate()`, never shown to an agent.
for.title: For

of.description: Entity type or expression giving items; omit for a single line.
of.title: Of

show.description: Template for one item (or the single line).
show.title: Show

empty.description: Text when no items match (omit to hide the view).
empty.title: Empty

when.description: Show it only when true ($actor, $stage): e.g. "$stage in ['trade']".
when.title: When

look.description: Offer it on demand as look(view) instead of always including it. Randomness a view draws is fixed for the turn: looking again shows the same text.
look.title: Look

bullet.description: Prefix each item with '- ' (false for boards and tables).
bullet.title: Bullet

attach.description: Assets delivered with the view: an expression giving an asset id, a list or null — per listed item ($it) with `of`, else once ($actor).
attach.title: Attach

ViewSpec.title: ViewSpec

description: An environment: world, people, rules, what agents see, what is measured.

name.description: Its title: the heading of every agent's brief. Left out, a contract read from a file is named after the file, any other `Environment`.
name.title: Name

imports.description: Extended section. Contract files merged into this one (paths relative to this file, inside its folder); this contract's own entries win. Imported files may import others.
imports.title: Imports

brief.description: Core section. Static text every agent reads first: the situation, the rules, and per-type role text.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Core section. Typed values supplied when the contract is loaded ($inputs.x): knobs, data tables, and the files the environment carries (`type: file`; see guide('assets')).

clock.description: Core section. How long a run lasts (`rounds`, default 20) and what one round is called.

space.description: Extended section. Positions: a grid, a graph of places or a plane, with values on cells.

types.title: Types
types.description: Core section. Kinds of entities and their properties; `agent: true` makes a type act, its `policies` are coded participants for its agents, for crowds and baselines (`policy:<name>`), and its `score` is what each of its agents scores as a seat, for tournaments, game search and gyms.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Core section. Named entities (the name defaults to the id), and generated ones: `count` of them, or one per data row (`from`), with sampled traits; ids `<key>_<n>`.

relations.title: Relations
relations.description: Extended section. Typed links between entities (trust, follows), with fields, and the links made at build (`links`): listed, from data rows, or generated networks.

records.title: Records
records.description: Core section. Append-only logs (chat, reviews, bids) with per-viewer visibility; written with `post`.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Core section. What agents can do: each is one typed tool with requirements and atomic effects.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Core section. The steps of every round: who acts, how (sequential or sealed simultaneous), which actions.

views.title: Views
views.description: Core section. What agents read each turn: single lines or ranked, filtered lists.

events.title: Events
events.description: Core section. What the world does outside agents' turns.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: Core section. The typed results of a run; with `series: true` also sampled every round ($outputs.x latest, $series.x every round).

end.title: End
end.description: Core section. Conditions that end the run early, with an optional winner ($result.winner in outputs).

arms.title: Arms
arms.description: Extended section. Experiment variants: input overrides or contract patches.

invariants.title: Invariants
invariants.description: Core section. Rules that must always hold.

defs.description: Extended section. Reusable expressions, called as $name(args), and effect lists, run with {"call": name, "with": {...}}.
defs.title: Defs

mechanisms.description: Extended section. Native building blocks by name: {name: {"kind": ..., ...config}}; see the guide's mechanisms part.
mechanisms.title: Mechanisms

title: Contract
